curriculum.sousTitre: Competences, prerequisites and planning — the foundation of learning analysis
curriculum.aQuoiSertTexte: Until an assessment is linked to a competence, a grade only says "12/20 in maths". Once linked, it says which competence is acquired — and prerequisites explain why a student is stuck.
curriculum.aucuneMatiereAide: Create your subjects first in Settings → Teaching.

curriculum.prerequisAide: What the student must master first. This link is what lets the system say why they are stuck, instead of merely noting failure.

erreurs.STRUCTURE_INVALIDE: The question structure is incomplete: check that every step has a prompt, an expected answer, and that the correct answer is among the options.
erreurs.FEUILLE_DEJA_TRAITEE: This worksheet is no longer awaiting approval — it is already {statut}.
erreurs.IA_INDISPONIBLE: No generation service is available right now. The bank can be filled in by hand in the meantime.
erreurs.FICHIER_INVALIDE: This file could not be read. Expected: a PDF.
erreurs.FICHIER_TROP_VOLUMINEUX: File too large (limit: {limiteMo} MB). Import the programme subject by subject rather than as one document.
erreurs.PDF_SANS_TEXTE: This PDF contains no text: it is a scanned image, and no image-reading engine is configured. Paste the programme into the text field, or provide a PDF that is not a scan.
erreurs.DOCUMENT_ILLISIBLE: The document was scanned, but nothing usable came out of it — too faint, skewed, or handwriting too tight. A better-lit photo, or typing the text in, settles it.
erreurs.OCR_INDISPONIBLE: No reading engine is available for this document. A handwritten sheet requires a model that can read images; in the meantime, the exercises can be pasted into the text field and the marks entered by hand.
erreurs.FEUILLE_PAPIER_INTROUVABLE: No paper sheet is awaiting marking for this class. Import the exercise sheet first, then scan the marked copies.
erreurs.POINTS_HORS_BAREME: A mark exceeds its exercise’s maximum. Correct it before saving — capping it for you would be inventing your decision.
erreurs.ADHESION_INTROUVABLE: No active membership to this tenant
erreurs.DEJA_REPONDU: You have already responded to this invitation
erreurs.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 8 characters long
erreurs.PASSWORD_MISSING_UPPERCASE: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
erreurs.PASSWORD_MISSING_LOWERCASE: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
erreurs.PASSWORD_MISSING_NUMBER: Password must contain at least one digit
erreurs.PASSWORD_MISSING_SPECIAL: Password must contain at least one special character (!@#$%^&*…)
erreurs.PASSWORD_SAME_AS_OLD: The new password must be different from the old one

• “How is it going?” — progress
• “What is stuck?” — difficulties

• “How are the fees?” — the balance

directionIntelligence.title: Director Intelligence
directionIntelligence.subtitle: Detection, diagnosis, prediction, prescription, measurement — steering on facts, not impressions.
directionIntelligence.sectionIndicesDescription: Seven indices reduced to a 0-1 score summarize the school's health. Missing data does not produce a false 0: it carries an "insufficient data" flag.
directionIntelligence.indiceROIVide: No completed plan allows measuring this index.
directionIntelligence.vitesseDescription: Average mastery Δ per day. Median {mediane}, {nb} samples.
directionIntelligence.sectionRisqueDescription: Five weighted signals per student, plus silent dropout detection — students whose mastery is declining without yet tipping into visible failure.
directionIntelligence.sectionNoeudsDescription: Hinge competencies: their failure blocks downstream competencies in cascade. Treating them first frees the largest number of students.
directionIntelligence.aucunNoeudCritique: No critical node detected — the curriculum graph exposes no hinge competency in failure at this time.
directionIntelligence.sectionSimulationDescription: Projection of the impact of each possible remediation, prioritized by pedagogical ROI (students saved / cost).
directionIntelligence.aucunScenario: No remediation scenario available — no unresolved mandatory recommendation at this time.
directionIntelligence.sectionEfficaciteDescription: What the system has learned from plan history: average mastery Δ, success rate, most effective teachers, winning intervention type.
directionIntelligence.aucunPlanEnseignant: No plan completed by a teacher yet.
directionIntelligence.sectionMesureDescription: Collection rate, payment delay, parental engagement → mastery correlation, AI adoption: the concrete levers of steering.
